title: kramastotra — kram-p10-v10
question: Within You-alone-one, of throbbing glory, of the knowledge-ocean, the taste of varied wave-masses spreading by own taste — they indeed, these creation-keeping-dissolving-formed ones, of moon-sun-fires' clash-gleams, at once are rise-and-set powers.
issue: Derived from L2 text (no argmap). Within You-alone-one, of throbbing glory, of the knowledge-ocean, the taste of varied wave-masses spreading by own taste — they indeed, these creation-keeping-dissolving-formed ones, of moon-sun-fires' clash-gleams, at once are rise-and-set powers.
